result:
Authors can now edit their own comments, but I haven't run tests, lint or the app, so none of it has been checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with the new body. It validates the body with Zod and refreshes the comments list after saving.
- **Success message:** the hook shows a "Comment Updated" notification. I put it there instead of in the component because `features/CLAUDE.md` says success notifications belong in the `api/` mutation hook. The older components still use the other pattern, so they don't match this rule.
- **UI:** `components/update-comment.tsx` is an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer pre-filled with the current body. In `comments-list.tsx` it only appears when the comment's author is the current user. Admins still get Delete on every comment but Edit only on their own.
- **Mock backend:** I added a `PATCH` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` so the feature works against the MSW mocks. It only updates comments authored by the logged-in user, and returns 404 otherwise.

I didn't add a policy to `lib/authorization.tsx`. The author check is inline in the list.
